1.web: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
1.asv: He that being often reproved hardeneth his neck Shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

2.web: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
2.asv: When the righteous are increased, the people rejoice; But when a wicked man beareth rule, the people sigh.

3.web: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
3.asv: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father; But he that keepeth company with harlots wasteth his substance.

4.web: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.
4.asv: The king by justice establisheth the land; But he that exacteth gifts overthroweth it.

5.web: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
5.asv: A man that flattereth his neighbor Spreadeth a net for his steps.

6.web: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.
6.asv: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare; But the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

7.web: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.
7.asv: The righteous taketh knowledge of the cause of the poor; The wicked hath not understanding to know it.

8.web: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.
8.asv: Scoffers set a city in a flame; But wise men turn away wrath.

9.web: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
9.asv: If a wise man hath a controversy with a foolish man, Whether he be angry or laugh, there will be no rest.

10.web: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.
10.asv: The bloodthirsty hate him that is perfect; And as for the upright, they seek his life.

11.web: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
11.asv: A fool uttereth all his anger; But a wise man keepeth it back and stilleth it.

12.web: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
12.asv: If a ruler hearkeneth to falsehood, All his servants are wicked.

13.web: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both.
13.asv: The poor man and the oppressor meet together; Jehovah lighteneth the eyes of them both.

14.web: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
14.asv: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, His throne shall be established for ever.

15.web: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
15.asv: The rod and reproof give wisdom; But a child left to himself causeth shame to his mother.

16.web: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
16.asv: When the wicked are increased, transgression increaseth; But the righteous shall look upon their fall.

17.web: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
17.asv: Correct thy son, and he will give thee rest; Yea, he will give delight unto thy soul.

18.web: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
18.asv: Where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; But he that keepeth the law, happy is he.

19.web: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
19.asv: A servant will not be corrected by words; For though he understand, he will not give heed.

20.web: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
20.asv: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? There is more hope of a fool than of him.

21.web: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
21.asv: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child Shall have him become a son at the last.

22.web: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
22.asv: An angry man stirreth up strife, And a wrathful man aboundeth in transgression.

23.web: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
23.asv: A man’s pride shall bring him low; But he that is of a lowly spirit shall obtain honor.

24.web: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.
24.asv: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul; He heareth the adjuration and uttereth nothing.

25.web: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
25.asv: The fear of man bringeth a snare; But whoso putteth his trust in Jehovah shall be safe.

26.web: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from Yahweh.
26.asv: Many seek the ruler’s favor; But a man’s judgmentcomethfrom Jehovah.

27.web: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
27.asv: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous; And he that is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.
